messages:
Nina: quick wrap 1: roundup from sales/support today about pin requests. want a short-term policy we can actually ship next sprint, and a medium-term spec for Q3.

Rahul: agreed. sales handed 4 asks: 2 paid pin extensions, 1 sticky-pin for embed stability, 1 migration-credit request for forced upgrades.

Jess: product stance: we can do a conservative MVP: approval flow + smoke-eval + customer acceptance. avoid reserving capacity for now. label pins as 'best-effort' in UI.

Kai: infra: sticky pins without reservations cause fragmentation. we can add a reservation SKU later, but short-term we should limit pins by quota and require signed acceptance.

Nina: proposed MVP rules: (a) max 180d pin, (b) auto-run 30-prompt smoke eval at approval, (c) CS approval for <$100k ARR, legal+CS for enterprise, (d) manual migration-credit handling.

Rahul: sales OK with that if we provide a templated comm and migration playbook. they want a simple billing UI flag so they can mark paid pins when contracted.

Jess: launch checklist: approval UI + backend flag, smoke-eval runner + snapshot storage in catalog, comm template + acceptance form, console label + telemetry for pinned tail-latency.

Kai: infra tasks: add catalog flag, expose pinned_fraction metric, create alert when pinned_fraction > 20%. we can ship these in 1 sprint if scoped.

roadmap-bot: Reminder: roadmap sync tomorrow 1500 PT calendar

Nina: action items: Rahul draft sales comm & billing flag usage (EOD), Jess own smoke-eval set + thresholds (tomorrow), Kai scope infra tickets for flag + metric (EOD). If all green, flip feature-flag next week for small beta.

Rahul: will prepare comm and template.

Jess: will pair with QA on 30 prompts and pass criteria (no >3% NLU drop, p95 <= baseline*1.25).

Kai: will create infra tickets and mock reservation work for Q3.

Nina: thanks team thumbsup: let's keep this tight and revisit paid reservations after beta feedback.
